name: Tyrdaiisy
source:
Tyr is in a new town to move in with a couple of his friends. Little does he know that somethings about to cause a rapidly growing problem. Well, its a problem for everyone else. For Tyr, it's a dream come true.

[From [url=https://dragonien.itch.io/tyrdaiisy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation: Tyr搬到一座新城镇，准备和几位朋友一起生活。他不知道，很快就会有某件事引发迅速扩大的麻烦。当然，这对其他所有人来说都是麻烦；对Tyr而言，却是梦想成真。[引自[url=https://dragonien.itch.io/tyrdaiisy]Itch.io[/url]]
